svg.text: 1,312 hand-derived gradients, each against the derivative that measures it
2-block GPT, 29 parameter tensors, central differences at eps = 1e-5, one run of examples/gradcheck.py
against the 1e-04 relative tolerance CI enforces
24 of the 1,312 coordinates are exactly zero in both, embedding rows this batch never touches, so the axes hold 1,288.
the worst disagreement is 3.06e-07 relative, which at this scale sits 5e-06 of a pixel off the line.
